info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Actinoli Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Actinoli Battery Detail Catalog API enables users to create and manage detailed entries for Actinoli batteries within the product catalog. This API is designed for businesses looking to enhance their battery offerings by providing comprehensive specifications and features. Typical consumers include e-commerce platforms, inventory management systems, and product catalogs that require accurate battery information. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline product listings and improve customer access to detailed battery data.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to submit detailed information regarding Actinoli batteries. It processes incoming requests and stores the provided data for future reference. Make sure to abide by the formatting requirements when submitting data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide the necessary details for the Actinoli battery. It includes specific attributes required for processing the battery information.

200.description: The request was processed successfully and the details are returned.

CreateCatalogActinoliBatteryDetailReques.title: Battery Details Request

actinoli_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the Actinoli battery being requested.

requestedBy.description: The name of the individual or entity requesting the battery.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the battery.

CreateCatalogActinoliBatteryDetailReques.description: Schema representing the details required to request battery operation.
